what: This site counts page views and reading time, with no IP address kept, no cookie and no user-agent string, as promptugal.news does. Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control and the Pause switch in the footer stop it. What is counted: https://promptugal.news/newsroom/observability/index.html
about: live.promptugal.news's page views and reads, sent by assets/obs/obs.js into live's own observability vault, made by live.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 18 November 2026 at Dinis Cruz's word (tools/obs-setup-live.py). Public on purpose: each append token can only append to its lane, and the key can only encrypt. The drain is conductor.b@PrompTugal.dinis's (credentials sealed to its key). The geo lookup list is read from promptugal.news's obs.json (config_from).
